__slots__ = ("name", "params", "result", "requires", "scope")

    def __init__(self, name, params, result, requires, scope):
        self.name = name
        self.params = params          # list of (name, Type)
        self.result = result          # (name, Type)
        self.requires = requires      # callable or None
        self.scope = scope            # name -> Type


def build_modules(definitions, table) -> dict:
    if not isinstance(definitions, list):
        raise InvalidCampaign("modules must be a list")
    modules = {}
    for definition in definitions:
        _need(isinstance(definition, dict), "module must be an object")
        name = _identifier(definition.get("name"))
        _need(name not in modules, "duplicate module name")
        raw_params = definition.get("params")
        _need(isinstance(raw_params, list), "module params must be a list")
        _need(len(raw_params) <= 16, "too many module parameters")
        params = []
        scope = {}
        for entry in raw_params:
            _need(isinstance(entry, list) and len(entry) == 2,
                  "parameter pair expected")
            pname = _identifier(entry[0])
            tname = entry[1]
            _need(isinstance(tname, str) and tname in table, "unknown parameter type")
            _need(pname not in scope, "duplicate parameter name")
            scope[pname] = table[tname]
            params.append((pname, table[tname]))
        raw_result = definition.get("result")
        _need(isinstance(raw_result, list) and len(raw_result) == 2,
              "module result pair expected")
        rname = _identifier(raw_result[0])
        rtname = raw_result[1]
        _need(isinstance(rtname, str) and rtname in table, "unknown result type")
        result_type = table[rtname]
        _need(isinstance(result_type, Void) or not isinstance(underlying(result_type), Void)
              or True, "result type")
        if isinstance(underlying(result_type), Void):
            pass
        _need(rname not in scope, "result name collides with a parameter")
        requires = definition.get("requires")
        predicate = None
        if requires is not None:
            predicate = compile_predicate(requires, scope, table)
        modules[name] = Module(name, params, (rname, result_type), predicate, scope)
    return modules

_FORMS = ("var", "const", "field", "index", "all", "match", "not")
_BINARY = ("eq", "ne", "lt", "le", "gt", "ge", "add", "sub",
           "and", "or", "implies")
_MISSING = object()
